protocol.understat_tuning_period: Before 2016-01-01; reported as sensitivity, not the primary test.
protocol.primary_test: Apply the StatsBomb-selected coefficient to Understat five-match npxG on the 190-match holdout.
protocol.same_date_rule: All matches on a date are predicted before results or xG from that date are observed.

decision.rule: Provider robustness passes only if frozen Understat npxG improves holdout log loss and the entire interval is below zero.
decision.result: Not passed: independent-provider npxG did not clear the uncertainty gate.

limitations: The providers are independent measurements, but the same EPL outcomes are used in both feature audits.
Understat data come from a pinned community mirror; original publication timestamps and model training history are unavailable.
Fixture-level npxG is matched; individual shots are not reconciled one by one.
One historical EPL season does not establish current UEFA transfer or pregame availability.
